Card Q&A.a: You place them at the bottom of your deck in any order.
Card Q&A.q: What happens to the cards that weren't added to my hand from among the cards revealed by this card’s effects?

Effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Knightmon] or [DeadlyAxemon] in its name or the [Twilight] trait among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
[Opponent's Turn] All of your Digimon with [DarkKnightmon] in their names or the [Twilight] trait gain ＜Blocker＞.
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
